ei.subject: 공통영어1
ei.title: Don't Let Anger Be Your Boss

fullPassage:
Do you ever find yourself suddenly feeling angry? One moment you're fine, and the next moment you're slamming doors or rolling your eyes at your parents. Some people may think you just have a bad attitude or are getting too upset about a small problem. However, these feelings don't simply come from stress about everyday life.

As a teen, you may feel like an adult, but your brain is still growing. In your brain, there is a part that is responsible for solving problems and controlling your emotions. In your teen years, this part is still in development. The changes in your brain lead you toward independence, social engagement, and creativity. At the same time, however, you may feel confused about who you are. You may also be more sensitive to unfairness. Furthermore, your body is flowing with hormones. This significantly affects your mood. The combination of these factors intensifies your strong emotions.

It is natural to feel angry from time to time; it doesn't mean there is something wrong with you. Anger can sometimes be a useful tool. For example, an angry but open conversation can resolve a conflict between friends. The important thing is to manage your anger so that it does not turn into aggressive or violent behavior. This does not mean that you should stop yourself from feeling angry. Rather, you should express it in a productive way. Ask yourself some questions about your angry feelings. This can help you to better understand your anger.

You need to learn how to deal with anger in a socially appropriate way. Remember: anger is a feeling, but behavior is a choice. The first step is recognizing the physical signs of anger. It is possible to recognize those signs in advance. They include an increased heart rate, a flushed face, and the clenching of your fists. When these things happen, take action to reduce your anger. For example, you could try taking a break to organize your thoughts or ending a conversation before it gets too intense.

In some cases, the strategies mentioned above may not be enough, so you may need to find proper coping skills for your personal situation. Without the right coping skills, you may find yourself becoming verbally or even physically aggressive. Explore various strategies to discover what is best for you, such as taking a walk, drawing a picture, or writing down things that come to your mind. You can also try to find possible solutions to a problem and then compare the advantages and disadvantages of each one. By developing problem-solving skills, you will learn that there are many ways to solve a problem without getting angry.

Anger is an emotion that we all experience. By managing your anger properly, you can be the boss of your feelings, not the other way around. This is an important step in finding your true self and taking control of your life.

questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 당신은 갑자기 화가 나는 경우가 있는가? 한 순간 당신은 괜찮다가 다음 순간에 문을 꽝 닫거나 부모님께 눈을 치켜뜬다. 어떤 사람들은 당신이 그저 태도가 나쁘거나 작은 문제에 너무 화를 낸다고 생각할지도 모른다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① feeling: find yourself feeling (지각동사 + 현재분사) 정상.
✅ ② rolling: or로 slamming과 병렬. 현재분사 정상.
❌ ④ is → are: 주어가 you이므로 'are getting'이 맞음.
✅ ③ everyday: '일상의'라는 형용사로 life를 수식. 정상.
det.tip: you are getting (주어-동사 수일치) / find yourself ~ing: ~하는 것을 발견하다 / everyday(형용사) vs every day(부사)

questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 때때로 화가 나는 것은 자연스러우며 그것은 당신에게 문제가 있다는 것을 뜻하지 않는다. 화는 가끔 쓸모 있는 도구가 될 수 있다. 중요한 것은 당신의 화가 공격적이거나 폭력적인 행동으로 변하지 않도록 화를 관리하는 것이다. 이는 당신이 화를 느끼는 것을 멈추어야 한다는 것을 의미하지 않는다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ resolve: 조동사 can 뒤 동사원형. 정상.
✅ ② to manage: The important thing is to manage (주격보어 to부정사). 정상.
❌ ① feel → feeling: stop ~ from ~ing 구문. from 뒤에 동명사가 와야 함.
✅ ④ productive: 형용사로 way를 수식. 정상.
det.tip: stop A from ~ing: A가 ~하는 것을 막다 / prevent/keep/prohibit A from ~ing도 동일 패턴

questions.passage: You need to learn how to deal with anger in a socially appropriate way. Remember: anger is a feeling, but behavior is a choice. The first step is ①<u>recognizing</u> the physical signs of anger. It is possible ②<u>to recognize</u> those signs in advance. They include an increased heart rate, a ③<u>flushing</u> face, and the clenching of your fists. When these things happen, take action ④<u>to reduce</u> your anger.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 당신은 사회적으로 적절한 방식으로 화를 다스리는 방법을 배워야 한다. 기억하라: 화는 감정이지만 행동은 선택이다. 첫 번째 단계는 화의 신체적 징후를 알아차리는 것이다. 그러한 징후를 미리 알아차리는 것은 가능하다. 그것들은 증가한 심박수, 빨개진 얼굴, 그리고 주먹을 꽉 쥐는 것을 포함한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① recognizing: The first step is recognizing (주격보어 동명사). 정상.
✅ ② to recognize: It is possible to recognize (가주어-진주어). 정상.
❌ ③ flushing → flushed: '빨개진(상태)' 얼굴. 과거분사가 명사를 수식해야 함. flushing은 '빨개지는 중인'으로 어색.
✅ ④ to reduce: take action to reduce (목적 부사적 용법). 정상.
det.tip: flushed face(빨개진 얼굴) — 과거분사가 형용사로 사용 / increased heart rate도 동일 패턴 / flushing(능동, 진행)은 부적절

questions.stem: 위 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 어떤 경우에는 위에 언급한 전략이 충분하지 않을 수 있으므로 적절한 대처 기술을 찾아야 할지도 모른다. 산책하기, 그림 그리기, 혹은 마음에 떠오르는 것들을 적기와 같은 다양한 전략을 탐구해라.
det.analysis:
✅ ② mind: come to your mind(마음에 떠오르다). 원문 그대로.
❌ ① hand: come to your hand는 자연스럽지 않음.
❌ ③ sight: come to your sight는 가능하나 원문과 다름.
❌ ④ place: come to your place(집에 오다)로 문맥 부적합.
det.tip: come to one's mind: 마음에 떠오르다 / things that come to mind: 생각나는 것들

questions.passage:
Do you ever find yourself suddenly feeling angry? One moment you're fine, and the next moment you're slamming doors or rolling your eyes at your parents. Some people may think you just have a bad attitude or are getting too upset about a small problem. However, these feelings don't simply come from stress about everyday life.

As a teen, you may feel like an adult, but your brain is still growing. In your brain, there is a part that is responsible for solving problems and controlling your emotions. In your teen years, this part is still in development. The changes in your brain lead you toward independence, social engagement, and creativity. At the same time, however, you may feel confused about who you are. You may also be more sensitive to unfairness. Furthermore, your body is flowing with hormones. This significantly affects your mood. The combination of these factors intensifies your strong emotions.

It is natural to feel angry from time to time; it doesn't mean there is something wrong with you. Anger can sometimes be a useful tool. For example, an angry but open conversation can resolve a conflict between friends. The important thing is to manage your anger so that it does not turn into aggressive or violent behavior. This does not mean that you should stop yourself from feeling angry. Rather, you should express it in a productive way. Ask yourself some questions about your angry feelings. This can help you to better understand your anger.

You need to learn how to deal with anger in a socially appropriate way. Remember: anger is a feeling, but behavior is a choice. The first step is recognizing the physical signs of anger. It is possible to recognize those signs in advance. They include an increased heart rate, a flushed face, and the clenching of your fists. When these things happen, take action to reduce your anger. For example, you could try taking a break to organize your thoughts or ending a conversation before it gets too intense.

In some cases, the strategies mentioned above may not be enough, so you may need to find proper coping skills for your personal situation. Without the right coping skills, you may find yourself becoming verbally or even physically aggressive. Explore various strategies to discover what is best for you, such as taking a walk, drawing a picture, or writing down things that come to your mind. You can also try to find possible solutions to a problem and then compare the advantages and disadvantages of each one. By developing problem-solving skills, you will learn that there are many ways to solve a problem without getting angry.

Anger is an emotion that we all experience. By managing your anger properly, you can be the boss of your feelings, not the other way around. This is an important step in finding your true self and taking control of your life.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용으로 보아 다음 진술이 맞으면 T, 틀리면 F를 고르시오.
"화의 신체적 징후에는 심박수 감소, 창백한 얼굴, 주먹을 쥐는 것이 포함된다."

det.korean: 화의 신체적 징후를 알아차리는 것이 첫 번째 단계이다. 그것들은 증가한 심박수, 빨개진 얼굴, 그리고 주먹을 꽉 쥐는 것을 포함한다.
det.analysis: ❌ F: '심박수 감소'는 틀림(원문: increased heart rate, 증가한 심박수). '창백한 얼굴'도 틀림(원문: flushed face, 빨개진 얼굴). 주먹 쥐는 것만 맞음.
det.tip: increased(증가한) ↔ decreased(감소한) / flushed(빨개진) ↔ pale(창백한) — 세부사항 변조 주의

questions.passage: It is natural to feel angry from time to time; it doesn't mean there is something wrong with you. The important thing is to manage your anger so that it does not turn into aggressive or violent behavior. This does not mean that you should stop yourself from feeling angry. Rather, you should express it in a __________ way.
questions.stem: 위 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 화를 관리하여 공격적 행동으로 변하지 않게 하라. 이는 화를 멈추라는 뜻이 아니라, 생산적인 방식으로 표현하라는 것이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ productive: 화를 멈추지 말되 '생산적으로' 표현하라는 맥락.
❌ ① destructive: 파괴적 방식은 aggressive와 같은 맥락.
❌ ② passive: 수동적 방식은 Rather의 적극적 어조와 불일치.
❌ ④ aggressive: 바로 앞에서 aggressive를 피하라 했으므로 모순.
det.tip: productive(생산적인): 건설적으로 화를 표현하는 방법 / Rather: 오히려 (앞 문장 부정 후 대안 제시)

questions.passage: By developing problem-solving skills, you will learn that there are many ways to solve a problem without getting angry. Anger is an emotion that we all experience. By managing your anger properly, you can be the boss of your feelings, not the other way around. This is an important step in finding your true self and __________.
questions.stem: 위 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: ② taking control of your life
④ depending on others for help

det.korean: 화는 우리 모두가 겪는 감정이다. 화를 적절하게 다룸으로써 당신은 감정의 주도권을 가질 수 있다. 이것은 진정한 자아를 찾고 당신의 삶을 장악하는 데 있어 중요한 단계이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② taking control of your life: 원문 그대로.
❌ ① avoiding all negative emotions: 모든 부정적 감정을 피하라는 극단적 주장은 본문 취지와 맞지 않음.
❌ ③ suppressing your anger completely: 화를 완전히 억누르라는 것은 본문이 명시적으로 부정한 내용.
❌ ④ depending on others for help: 타인 의존은 문맥과 무관.
det.tip: take control of: ~을 장악하다, 통제하다 / finding your true self: 진정한 자아를 찾다

questions.passage:
Do you ever find yourself suddenly feeling angry? One moment you're fine, and the next moment you're slamming doors or rolling your eyes at your parents. Some people may think you just have a bad attitude or are getting too upset about a small problem. However, these feelings don't simply come from stress about everyday life.

As a teen, you may feel like an adult, but your brain is still growing. In your brain, there is a part that is responsible for solving problems and controlling your emotions. In your teen years, this part is still in development. The changes in your brain lead you toward independence, social engagement, and creativity. At the same time, however, you may feel confused about who you are. You may also be more sensitive to unfairness. Furthermore, your body is flowing with hormones. This significantly affects your mood. The combination of these factors intensifies your strong emotions.

It is natural to feel angry from time to time; it doesn't mean there is something wrong with you. Anger can sometimes be a useful tool. For example, an angry but open conversation can resolve a conflict between friends. The important thing is to manage your anger so that it does not turn into aggressive or violent behavior. This does not mean that you should stop yourself from feeling angry. Rather, you should express it in a productive way. Ask yourself some questions about your angry feelings. This can help you to better understand your anger.

You need to learn how to deal with anger in a socially appropriate way. Remember: anger is a feeling, but behavior is a choice. The first step is recognizing the physical signs of anger. It is possible to recognize those signs in advance. They include an increased heart rate, a flushed face, and the clenching of your fists. When these things happen, take action to reduce your anger. For example, you could try taking a break to organize your thoughts or ending a conversation before it gets too intense.

In some cases, the strategies mentioned above may not be enough, so you may need to find proper coping skills for your personal situation. Without the right coping skills, you may find yourself becoming verbally or even physically aggressive. Explore various strategies to discover what is best for you, such as taking a walk, drawing a picture, or writing down things that come to your mind. You can also try to find possible solutions to a problem and then compare the advantages and disadvantages of each one. By developing problem-solving skills, you will learn that there are many ways to solve a problem without getting angry.

Anger is an emotion that we all experience. By managing your anger properly, you can be the boss of your feelings, not the other way around. This is an important step in finding your true self and taking control of your life.

det.analysis:
✅ ② 원문의 핵심 메시지: 화를 '적절히 관리(managing properly)' → 감정의 주인(boss of feelings).
❌ ① 억눌러야 한다: 본문은 '멈추지 말라(not stop)'고 함.
❌ ③ 완전히 제거: 화는 자연스러운 감정(natural)이라 했음.
❌ ④ 다른 사람 도움 없이 불가능: 타인 의존 언급 없음.
det.tip: be the boss of your feelings: 감정의 주인이 되다 / not the other way around: 그 반대가 아니라
